method: Re-read only the neutral case file, permitted pinned source texts, permitted housing.sources.json/family-housing.sources.json registry slices, and exact mirrored XML versions selected by those registry identities. Source version intervals and LEGI IDs are given per citation. No model, CLIR, tests, helpers, or generators were opened or run.

corrections.answer: The stipulated conventioned rental and principal residence support the APL field, subject to claimant conditions not all supplied. No amount can be computed from €650 rent alone.

citations.quote: ... logements à usage locatif ... à condition que ces bailleurs s'engagent à respecter les obligations précisées par des conventions ...
Le montant des aides personnelles au logement est calculé en fonction d'un barème défini par voie réglementaire.

corrections.answer: ASF receipt and a dependent child place this household within the express ALF category; eligibility remains subject to common requirements. No ALF amount follows from the facts alone.

citations.quote: L'allocation de logement familiale est accordée : 1° Aux personnes qui perçoivent ... l'allocation de soutien familial ...
Le montant des aides personnelles au logement est calculé en fonction d'un barème défini par voie réglementaire.

corrections.answer: ALS is the residual allowance once neither ALF nor APL is available; the case stipulates no such entitlement. Age/hostel facts alone do not establish every other condition, so entitlement and amount remain conditional.

citations.quote: Les personnes ne bénéficiant pas de l'allocation de logement familiale ou de l'aide personnalisée au logement peuvent prétendre au bénéfice de l'allocation de logement sociale.

corrections.answer: The second simultaneous aid is excluded: APL and ALF are mutually exclusive. The selection priority in a case eligible for multiple aid types is left to regulation, but that is immaterial where APL is already attributed for the same month.

citations.quote: Le bénéfice de l'une des trois aides personnelles au logement mentionnées à l'article L. 821-1 est exclusif du bénéfice de l'une ou des deux autres.

corrections.answer: No concurrent AL is attributable to the other spouse for the same household/dwelling/month while APL is already attributed. The rule states exclusivity, rather than an independent personal election by each spouse.

citations.quote: Le bénéfice de l'une des trois aides personnelles au logement mentionnées à l'article L. 821-1 est exclusif du bénéfice de l'une ou des deux autres.

corrections.answer: The studio is occupied five nights weekly, about 260 nights/year, exceeding the ordinary eight-month minimum; the two nights away are stated to be professional travel, which is also an express exception. On those stated recurring facts, the studio is the principal residence for this condition.

citations.quote: ... logement effectivement occupé ... au moins huit mois par an, sauf obligation professionnelle, raison de santé ou cas de force majeure.

corrections.answer: Required area for five occupants is 16 m² + 3×9 m² = 43 m²; 35 m² is short by 8 m². No derogation is stipulated. This determines the area test, not every other entitlement condition.

citations.quote: ... seize mètres carrés pour un ménage sans enfant ou deux personnes, augmentée de neuf mètres carrés par personne en plus ...

corrections.answer: The student forfait rule applies if its age and study conditions are met. At 22/full-time student, no scholarship means the rule's scholarship reduction does not apply; the forfait amount itself is not supplied by the case and cannot be stated here.

citations.quote: ... occupe un logement à usage locatif, qu'il satisfait les conditions d'âge fixées pour l'attribution d'une bourse ... et poursuit des études, les ressources ... sont réputées égales à un montant forfaitaire. Ce montant est minoré lorsque ... titulaire d'une bourse ... non assujettie à l'impôt sur le revenu.
Les montants mentionnés à l'article R. 822-20 sont fixés par arrêté ... Ils sont arrondis à la centaine d'euros la plus proche.

corrections.answer: The case stipulates patrimoine above €30,000, no retained income, and the relevant rental values. Applying the source factors to those given inputs: built property €12,000×50%=€6,000/year; unimproved land €4,000×80%=€3,200/year; total imputed annual resources from these assets = €9,200. This is a conditional computation on stated values, not independent proof of their legal valuation or threshold treatment.

citations.quote: Le montant ... est fixé à 30 000 euros ... Ce patrimoine est considéré comme procurant un revenu annuel égal à 50 % de sa valeur locative s'il s'agit d'immeubles bâtis, à 80 % de cette valeur s'il s'agit de terrains non bâtis ...

corrections.answer: This is a move into a conventioned dwelling and conditions are stipulated met in April. R823-14 displaces the ordinary first-rent-due rule: APL right opens 1 April 2022, despite filing on 20 April.

citations.quote: Par dérogation aux dispositions des articles R. 831-2, R. 832-6 et R. 832-8, en cas de déménagement ... le droit ... est ouvert à compter du premier jour du mois civil au cours duquel les conditions d'ouverture du droit sont réunies.

corrections.answer: For cessation by move, R823-14 makes the right expire on the last day of the month in which conditions cease. Permanent departure on 8 June therefore leaves June due.

citations.quote: en cas de déménagement ... le droit ... s'éteint le dernier jour du mois civil au cours duquel ces conditions cessent d'être réunies.

corrections.answer: For the activity-income category counted from the 13th to 2nd month before August 2023, the period is July 2022 through June 2023 (13th month = July 2022; 2nd = June 2023). This corrects the earlier one-month-early interval. Other categories use their separate R822-3 periods.

citations.quote: ... une période de référence courant du treizième au deuxième mois précédant la date d'ouverture ou de réexamen du droit ...

corrections.answer: MSA is the competent paying body for a beneficiary under the agricultural social-protection scheme; rural location is not the criterion stated in this rule.

citations.quote: ... lorsque le bénéficiaire relève d'un régime de protection sociale des professions agricoles, par la caisse de la mutualité sociale agricole compétente.

corrections.answer: For the stipulated APL €280 and rent plus recoverable charges €660, conditional excess is max(0, €280−€660)=€0. If paid to the landlord, the landlord deducts it from rent/charges; there is no amount exceeding them to remit to the tenant. The facts do not prove that the aid was correctly calculated or establish direct-payment mechanics beyond the stated landlord case.

citations.quote: La part de l'aide qui excède le montant du loyer et des charges récupérables est versée à l'allocataire.

corrections.answer: ALF €8 is below the applicable €10 threshold: no monthly payment. The €8 is a case-supplied computed value, not a finding of correct calculation.

citations.article: Arrêté, edition ARRETE_ED2023_01, operative at Jan 2023; applies to Sep 2023 absent later amendment in the pinned Oct edition
citations.quote: Le seuil de versement ... est fixé à 10 euros pour les allocations de logement et à 0 euro pour l'aide personnalisée au logement.

corrections.answer: The stipulated good faith requires the paying body to maintain payment when the beneficiary does not pay the housing expense. This uses the L824-2 version in force through 29 July 2023; the later wording must not be back-applied.

citations.quote: Si le bénéficiaire est de bonne foi, maintient le versement de l'aide personnelle au logement.

corrections.answer: The 2024 rule directs the payer to refer to CCAPEX for a maintain/not-maintain decision and to establish social/budgetary support. On the stipulated maintenance decision and plan, payment is maintained within the decision's scope; its duration and other terms are not supplied.

citations.quote: Saisit la commission ... afin qu'elle décide du maintien ou non du versement ; met en place les démarches d'accompagnement social et budgétaire du ménage.

corrections.answer: Once the ALF conservation procedure has been triggered by the competent finding/notice, tenant pays rent plus recoverable charges less the allocation informed by the payer: €500+€80−€200=€380 for the month, conditional on the stated amounts being those notified and applicable. The literal case says finding notified, but does not separately identify the payer notice to owner that starts the statutory clock.

citations.article: L843-1; version interval 2019-09-01..2999-01-01 in pinned registry row
citations.quote: Durant ce délai, le locataire s'acquitte du montant du loyer et des charges récupérables diminué du montant des allocations de logement, dont il a été informé par l'organisme payeur...

corrections.answer: The ordinary compliance deadline is 18 months; if non-compliance continues at its expiry, the conserved aid is not recovered by the owner and the owner cannot claim the corresponding unpaid rent from the tenant. Given the case's stated 18-month non-compliance by August 2023, that consequence follows if the stated period runs from the legally operative owner-notification date and no exceptional extension applies. The date of formal notification is not separately supplied.

citations.quote: Le délai mentionné au premier alinéa de l'article L. 843-1 est fixé à dix-huit mois.
Si, à l'issue du délai de mise en conformité prévu à l'article L. 843-1 ... le montant de l'allocation ... n'est pas récupéré par le propriétaire.

corrections.answer: When a dwelling becomes overcrowded because of a birth, the allowance is maintained by derogation for two years. The birth on 20 May 2023 is the stipulated trigger. Any extension requires a separate decision; the quoted rule does not itself state a month-end convention for the boundary.

citations.quote: Si un logement devient surpeuplé par suite d'une naissance ... les allocations sont maintenues, à titre dérogatoire, pendant une durée de deux ans.

corrections.answer: The remission request is deemed rejected because no decision was brought to the claimant's knowledge within the two-month decision period. 10 January + two calendar months expires 10 March 2023; by 1 April the deemed rejection has arisen. Timely acknowledgement is a separate receipt duty and does not extend that deadline.

citations.quote: Il dispose d'un délai de deux mois pour notifier sa décision ... Faute d'une décision ... dans ce délai de deux mois, la demande de remise gracieuse de dettes est réputée rejetée.

corrections.answer: If the landlord proves that aid had been deducted from rent under third-party payment and the tenant does not contest that those sums were undue, the sums are recoverable from the tenant under the referenced recovery procedure. The prompt supplies non-dispute but not the third-party-payment/deduction predicates; it does not establish a broader unilateral deduction power.

citations.quote: ... le bailleur ... justifie qu'il a ... déduit les sommes ... du montant du loyer ... et que le locataire ... ne conteste pas le caractère indu ... recouvrées ... auprès du locataire.

corrections.answer: A family-benefit claimant owner can qualify for the home-improvement loan only if the work is an eligible improvement/repair and claimant status/occupancy conditions hold. For €1,000 of eligible performed contractor expense, 80% is €800, below the ordinary €1,067.14 ceiling. Planned work alone does not establish the required expense already incurred or eligible work classification.

citations.quote: ... allocataires ayant la qualité de propriétaires ... travaux d'aménagement ou de réparations comportant une amélioration des conditions de logement.
Les prêts peuvent atteindre 80 % des dépenses effectuées ... dans la limite d'un maximum de 1 067,14 euros.

corrections.answer: Because this is the special assistant-maternel loan, 10 months is within the maximum. With €800 principal and ten equal principal fractions, principal is €80 each month; no interest is added. For award 15 February 2023, the sixth month following award is August 2023, the first due month under the source text.

citations.quote: ... les prêts accordés aux assistants maternels sont remboursables par fractions égales, en cent vingt mensualités au maximum, exigibles à compter du sixième mois qui en suit l'attribution. Aucune majoration d'intérêt ne peut être réclamée sur ces mensualités.

corrections.answer: On stipulated entitlement, the €300 same-purpose payment cannot cumulate; conditional balance is €1,000−€300=€700. Amounts are supplied facts, not legal rates. No separate L823-8 calculation is needed because retained scale amount is stipulated.

citations.quote: ... lorsque le montant ainsi versé est inférieur à celui de la prime ... la différence est versée par l'organisme payeur.

corrections.answer: D823-17 has an in-force interval from 1 January 2021 through 2999-01-01 in the pinned map, so July 2026 does not itself expire before November 2026. Under this frozen-law hypothetical, use its symbolic formula unless a later amendment is provided. No numerical PP can be returned because R, R0, P0, Tp and the 'named reading' definitions/branches are not supplied. Known conditional expression: Pp=P0+Tp×(R−R0); with R<R0 and positive Tp the resource term is negative. No future parameter values inferred.

citations.article: D823-17 / LEGIARTI000041419255; in_force_from 2021-01-01; in_force_to 2999-01-01; fragment CCH_D823_17_ED2026_07
citations.quote: Pp = P0 + Tp* (R-R0)
“R0” est un abattement forfaitaire appliqué aux ressources du ménage. Il est fixé par arrêté ...
